book.name: 2 Tesalonica
book.title: To Ikaduwa no Suyat ni Pablo diya to mgo Taga- Tesalonica

content: Na mgo suun, meyduon oghangyuon noy iyu bahin to pagkahimun ta duon ki Jesu-Cristo no Ginuu ta ko mupauli sikandin.

Kona kow dajun ogkalibod dow ogkahaedok ko makadinog kow no mig-abut on kun to panahon no og-andini to Ginuu to pagkastigu to mgo otow no wada pasakup kandin. Kona kow ogtuu to sikan inggad meyduon muiling no sikami to mig-ikagi ubin migsuyat to sikan, ubin kagi yagboy sikan to Diyus no impabaja kanami.
Inggad amonuhon dan to pagpatuu iyu, kona kow ogtuu. Su kona pad on ogkahitabu sikan, mahan-in hilabi to mgo otow no ogpag-atu to Diyus, aw ogyogwa isab sikan yawan-on yagboy no otow no impernuhonon.
Ogsupakon din to tibo no pigpakadiyus aw pigsimba to otow agun sikandin nasi to simbahon. Og-ingkud ngani duon to Bayoy to Diyus aw og-angkon no sikandin kun to Diyus.
Ogkadomdoman now da buwa no pignangonan kud on sikiyu to sikan no duma a now pad.
Aw namaanan now on dow nokoy to ogpakapogong to sikan yawan-on no otow agun no kona naa makayogwa kotob to panahon no pigbootan to Diyus.
Hinuun, miglihok on to gahom to madoot, di ayha da ogkatagahan yagboy ko magawang on sikan nakapogong.
Na, ko magawang on, ogyogwa sikan yawan-on no otow. Di ko mupauli on si Jesus no Ginuu dini to pasak, oghimatajan din sikan otow pinaagi to paghiyup dow to gamhanan no kasilow din.
Di ko kona pad mamatoy sikan yawan-on no otow, oggahoman sikandin ni Satanas agun makahinang to mgo milagru aw duma no mgo kabeynganan
dow mangkadoot agun malimbungan din to mgo otow no yagyagonon. Ogkailing no yagyagonon su kona dan ogdawaton sikan matuud bahin ki Cristo agun bogajan podom to kinabuhi no wada katapusan.
Kaling igtugut to Diyus no malimbungan sikandan aw makatuu to gayu.
Na, ogpahamtangan sikandan to kastigu su kona dan ogtuuhan to matuud aw iyan nasi igkalipay dan to madoot.
To Pagtagon to Hustu no Impang-anad

Di sikiyu no mgo suun noy no hinigugma to Ginuu, kinahangyan no pasalamatan noy kanunoy to Diyus tongod iyu. Su likat pad to sinugdanan, tahan kow din on pigpili agun mayuwas kow pinaagi to gahom to Ispiritu Santu. Sikandin to migbag-u iyu tongod to pagtuu now to sikan matuud no nawnangonon bahin ki Jesus.
Pigtawag kow din pinaagi to sikan Madojow no Nawnangonon no ingwali noy iyu agun mayakip kow to kadongganan ni Jesu-Cristo no Ginuu ta.
Kaling mgo suun, pakadigon kow to pagtuu, aw tagoni now yagboy to diya impang-anad noy no duma koy pad iyu hasta to diya impanuyat noy.

Na, og-ampu koy no dasigon kow aw digonon ni Jesu-Cristo no Ginuu ta dow to Amoy ta no Diyus agun no mupadajun kow to madojow no pagpang-ikagi dow hinang. Kanunoy ki oghigugmaon to Diyus, aw pinaagi to kadojow dow kayuuy din ita, wada katapusan to pagkadasig dow pag-iman ta.
